name: raw-concrete
title: Raw Concrete
summary: Brutalist: heavy display type, monospaced body, thick black borders, hard offsets and no rounding. For manifestos, agencies, indie products, music and culture sites.
imagery: High-contrast black-and-white photos, raw scans, hard crops; no soft lifestyle photography.
rules: Headlines in Dela Gothic One (it has weight 400 only), very large, uppercase allowed, lineHeight 0.95-1.05.
Body, labels and buttons in Martian Mono 400 or 500, 13-15 px.
Borders 2-3 px in the line colour around blocks and buttons; radius always 0.
Hard offset shadows only: a solid text-colour shadow at x 6, y 6, blur 0; nothing soft.
Accent as large flat fields or a highlight bar behind words; text on it uses on-accent.
Asymmetric layout: break the grid on purpose with one oversized element per screen.
No gradients, no rounded corners, no light greys for important text.
